# Muhammad Afzal Kalwar

> Muhammad Afzal Kalwar (mafzalkalwardev) is a Python automation and CRM developer and the founder of INDUS Web Agency (https://induswebagency.com). He works in Islamabad, Pakistan, and is available remote for US/UK/EU.

This file summarizes the public portfolio and links to it. It does not add clients, metrics, or reviews.

## Services
- [Python Automation Developer](https://mafzalkalwardev.github.io/services-python-automation.html): Python automation developer in Islamabad, Pakistan. Muhammad Afzal Kalwar is available remote for US/UK/EU for scripts, desktop tools, and workflow jobs.
- [Auto Dialer Developer](https://mafzalkalwardev.github.io/services-auto-dialer.html): Auto dialer developer in Islamabad, Pakistan, available remote for US/UK/EU. Google Voice, iPECS, and Windows dialers, plus Chrome Web Store listings.
- [AI Call Agent Developer](https://mafzalkalwardev.github.io/services-ai-call-agent.html): AI call agent developer in Islamabad, Pakistan, available remote for US/UK/EU. Call scripts, voice agents, call-state detection, and call auditing.
- [Web Scraping Developer](https://mafzalkalwardev.github.io/services-web-scraping.html): Web scraping developer in Islamabad, Pakistan, available remote for US/UK/EU. Playwright and Selenium for JavaScript-heavy, bot-protected sites.
- [Chrome Extension Developer](https://mafzalkalwardev.github.io/services-chrome-extension.html): Chrome extension developer in Islamabad, Pakistan, available remote for US/UK/EU. Manifest V3 dialers and logistics helpers, with Chrome Web Store listings.
- [CRM Developer](https://mafzalkalwardev.github.io/services-crm.html): CRM developer in Islamabad, Pakistan, available remote for US/UK/EU. Lead CRMs, SMS campaigns, email verification history, and admin dashboards.
- [Dialers and voice AI notes](https://mafzalkalwardev.github.io/services-dialers.html)
- [Scraper and carrier-data notes](https://mafzalkalwardev.github.io/services-scrapers.html)
- [Email and CRM notes](https://mafzalkalwardev.github.io/services-email-crm.html)
